Constraints: Use checked-out repository code and existing tests only. Do not alter git history, index baseline, or harness configuration.
EOF

item.text: The SDK already defines both registration token identifiers, so the dispatcher can recognize stable and unstable stages directly. I’m adding a single entry component that submits the server’s exact `loginType`; this preserves the advertised variant in the auth dictionary.

The entry now has the required labeled, autofocus token field, help text, alert styling, and primary button. Enter and clicking both reach the same guarded submit handler; I’m checking the repository’s existing auth tests and type checker now.

item.text:
Implemented registration-token support in [InteractiveAuthEntryComponents.tsx](/app/src/components/views/auth/InteractiveAuthEntryComponents.tsx). Both stable and MSC3231 stages now open a dedicated entry with the required field, label, help text, autofocus, accessible error, and primary action. Enter and clicking submit the same guarded handler, which sends the token with the server-advertised stage type.

Validation: the focused InteractiveAuth Jest test passed, ESLint passed, and `git diff --check` passed. The full TypeScript check reported unrelated existing Sliding Sync errors; it reported none in the changed component.
